name: Iron Hide
description: Harden the whole skin at once with metal qi so that a cut or a club glances off the user's body.

name: Plate Palm
description: Thrust the palm forward behind a flat plate of grown metal and slam it into one foe's chest.

name: Rooted Iron
description: Sink metal qi through the feet into the floor so the user stands against a shove or a charge like a bar driven into earth.

name: Gleam Reading
description: Look along a foe's plate or blade with metal qi and read from its sheen the wear, the cracks and the weak spot, for the user.

name: Bulwarkskin
description: Hold the whole body as a single plate of metal qi through a long exchange, so repeated blows do not wear it down.

name: Rimbash
description: Drive the edge of a grown plate into one foe's weapon arm from behind the shield, bruising the bone below.

name: Steelhold
description: Catch a foe's blade between two grown plates and clamp them shut so the weapon is held fast.

name: Unbroken Iron Mantle
description: Wrap the user in a mantle of layered grown iron that rebuilds each layer as it is struck, holding firm against several strong foes at once.

name: Ironclad Crush
description: Throw the full weight of the plated body behind a single blow that crushes a foe's guard and the arm behind it.

name: Edge Wave
description: Throw the cut of a blade forward as a short thin wave of metal qi that bites one foe a few paces off.

name: Thin Slash
description: Cut a narrow, fast stroke across one foe's forearm with a thread of metal qi along the edge.

name: Cutline Parry
description: Lay a thin line of qi along the flat of the blade to ride a foe's cut away from the user.

name: Cut Reading
description: Run metal qi over the line of a fresh cut in wood, cloth or stone and read the weapon and the hand that made it.

name: Edge Glide
description: Slide forward along the line of a cut on a skid of metal qi to close the gap in one motion.

name: Crescentcut
description: Loose a curved wave of metal qi that rakes a wide arc across the ranks of foes before the user.

name: Sunderline
description: Narrow the wave of qi to a needle-thin line that passes through one foe's armor and shield together.

name: Edgeward
description: Spin a ring of cutting lines about the user and slice thrown blades and arrows out of the air.

name: Severing Arc
description: Swing a single huge arc of metal qi that cleaves through a foe's weapon, guard and body in one line.

name: Reaving Sweep
description: Sweep the blade flat in a full circle and send a ring of cutting qi outward through every foe in reach.

name: Halo Feeling
description: Extend the halo a short way and feel through its rim who and what passes into the space about the user.

name: Halo Pulse
description: Snap the halo outward in one pulse so a close foe is pushed off his stroke.

name: Rim Skin
description: Thicken the halo's inner rim against the skin so a blow that gets through the outer ring still meets metal.

name: Halo Strike
description: Strike with a limb carried inside the halo so that the rim cuts as the blow lands.

name: Halo Glide
description: Roll the halo along the ground and let it carry the user a long pace to either side.

name: Ironhalo
description: Harden the whole halo to a ring of iron that holds out heavy blows from every side for a sustained while.

name: Edgehalo
description: Sharpen the rim of the halo and spin it so that every foe standing close to the user is cut as it turns.

name: Halosnare
description: Draw the halo in tight round a foe who has stepped inside it and hold his limbs against his sides.

name: Razor Orbit
description: Set the rim of the halo spinning at razor keenness about the user and hold it there, cutting down every foe who closes.

name: Bound Aegis
description: Compress the halo into a single dense shield before the user to take one huge blow without breaking.

name: Greave Bloom
description: Grow plated greaves of metal along the shins to turn low cuts and kicks.

name: Gauntlet Bloom
description: Grow armored gauntlets over the hands and forearms to take blows meant for the face.

name: Visor Bloom
description: Grow a close helm with a narrow visor of metal over the head to guard the eyes and skull.

name: Armor Edge
description: Grow a spiked rim along the grown vambrace and cut one foe with it in the course of a parry.

name: Armor Seed
description: Read the metal qi in the air about the user to learn how much armor it can be grown into, before the user commits to it.

name: Armor Stride
description: Move in full grown armor on a spring of metal qi, so the weight of the plates does not slow the user's step.

name: Cuirass Growth
description: Grow a thick cuirass over the torso that thickens further with each blow it takes.

name: Spiked Mantle
description: Raise a mantle of grown spikes across the shoulders so that a foe who grapples or strikes the user is cut by it.

name: Armor Shed
description: Burst the outer plates of grown armor off the body as flying fragments that strike every foe near the user.

name: Full Panoply
description: Grow a full panoply of plated metal from head to heel and maintain it, turning the strokes of several strong foes.

name: Panoply Burst
description: Detonate the whole panoply outward in a storm of plates, spikes and shards that strikes every foe in a wide circle.

name: Hammer Knuckle
description: Bring the closed fist down like a hammer head onto one foe's shoulder or helm.

name: Anvil Root
description: Settle the body low and dense as an anvil so that blows land and do not move the user.

name: Hammer Echo
description: Rap an object once with metal qi and read the echo for flaws, hollows and the thickness of what lies beneath.

name: Hammer Stride
description: Stamp forward in a heavy short stride that carries the user through a lighter foe's line.

name: Hammerfall
description: Bring both fists down together on a foe's raised guard so that the force goes through his arms into his body.

name: Anvil Cross
description: Set the forearms in an X before the chest as the head of an anvil and take a full overhead blow.

name: Hammerpeal
description: Strike the ground so that the peal of metal qi rattles the footing of every foe near the user.

name: Anvil Plummet
description: Leap and fall with the whole body gone dense as metal, landing a single blow that drives a foe and his guard down into the ground.

name: Sundering Hammer
description: Swing a huge fist-hammer of metal qi that breaks a foe's weapon and sets him staggering from the shock.

name: Hover Blade
description: Raise a single blade of metal qi beside the user and send it flying at one foe.

name: Floating Edge
description: Cut with a blade of qi that floats free of the hand and slashes in the air beside the user.

name: Blade Fan
description: Spread several hanging blades like the ribs of a fan to knock aside missiles and thrusts.

name: Edge Counting
description: Send a hanging blade through a room and feel from its touch how many blades, bows and hidden weapons are present.

name: Hanging Step
description: Step onto a hanging blade as a footing and spring from it a long pace in any direction.

name: Bladeward
description: Orbit a ring of hanging blades round the user to strike thrown weapons out of the air.

name: Pairflight
description: Loose two hanging blades along crossing paths so they meet at one foe from opposite sides.

name: Bladecloud
description: Scatter a dozen small blades over a wide space so they fall on every foe in front of the user.

name: Blade Tempest
description: Whirl a great host of hanging blades through the air about the user and keep them cutting, shredding all that stand within the storm.

name: Hovering Lance
description: Merge the hanging blades into one long lance of qi and drive it through a foe's armor and shield together.

name: Wire Weave
description: Weave a quick web of wires over the front of the body that stops a cut or a thrown blade.

name: Strand Flick
description: Flick a single sharp strand of wire qi across one foe's wrist or eyes.

name: Loom Reading
description: Lay wires along a floor or wall and read from their shiver every step, draught and weight in the room.

name: Weftdart Stride
description: Throw a wire across a gap, anchor it and cross on it in two quick strides.

name: Wireweb
description: Spread a web of wire qi across a foe's limbs and weapon and draw it taut, so each struggle tightens it.

name: Strand Rend
description: Draw a taut strand across a foe's sword hand so that it cuts the grip and tangles the weapon.

name: Loomed Net
description: Weave a net of wire qi in the foes' path and leave it unseen, so that the first to step into it is bound and the others are stopped.

name: Weaver's Edge
description: Pull many strands together into a single cutting wire and draw it through one foe's guard, weapon and flesh.

name: Slender Needle
description: Loose a fine needle of metal qi that flies fast and nearly unseen at one foe.

name: Needle Tether
description: Send a needle out on a thread and feel along the thread what it passes through before it returns.

name: Needle Parry
description: Meet a thrust with a short needle of qi at the point and turn it a hand's width aside.

name: Needle Hop
description: Plant a needle in a wall or post and vault off it to leave the foe's reach.

name: Needle Prick
description: Slide a needle of qi through a seam in a foe's armor into the joint beneath.

name: Needleflight
description: Keep needles streaming from both hands in a steady flight at one foe so that he cannot parry them all.

name: Needlepin
description: Pin a foe's long sleeves and hems to a post with a spread of needles so that he is held in place.

name: Needlefan
description: Throw a wide fan of needles that covers every foe in the arc before the user.

name: Thousand Needle Swarm
description: Loose a swarm of needles in numbers beyond counting from every side, so that the foes in front of the user can find no safe line.

name: Threaded Needle
description: Compress the metal qi to a single needle and drive it through the narrowest gap in a foe's defense to his heart.

name: Hook Pull
description: Snag a foe's cloak or belt with a hook of qi and drag him a step off his line.

name: Chain Drag
description: Swing a weighted chain of metal qi round to strike one foe and pull him down.

name: Hook Guard
description: Catch a foe's blade in a hooked guard and twist it off its line.

name: Chain Link Sensing
description: Feel along a chain of qi laid on the ground for any weight or movement that touches it.

name: Hookchain
description: Sink a barbed hook in a foe's armor and hold him on the chain while he strains to pull free.

name: Chainwhirl
description: Whirl a long chain in a wide circle about the user to strike every foe within its sweep.

name: Hookswing
description: Cast a hook to a beam or a high ledge and swing across or up in a single arc.

name: Barbed Chainlash
description: Lash a barbed chain across one foe so the barbs tear through guard and mail alike.

name: Dragging Anchor
description: Set a heavy anchor of qi in a foe's body and haul him in by the chain, however much he resists.

name: Silver Drop
description: Flick a heavy drop of liquid silver that strikes one foe and runs into the joints of his armor.

name: Flow Cloak
description: Let a cloak of liquid silver run over the body and swallow the force of blows.

name: Running Silver
description: Turn the legs to quicksilver and slide over rough ground in a single unbroken run.

name: Silver Salve
description: Spread cool silver qi over an ally's wounds, closing them and drawing out the heat of the hurt.

name: Mirror Read
description: Lay a still pool of silver on the ground and read in its surface every movement near the user.

name: Silver Whip
description: Lash a whip of liquid silver across one foe's hands and weapon.

name: Silverblade
description: Shape the silver into a blade that flows round a guard and cuts the flesh behind it.

name: Silverbarrier
description: Pour liquid silver into a thick moving barrier that closes on any blow that tries to pass.

name: Silvergrip
description: Pour silver over a foe's limbs and let it set, gripping them in a cold sleeve.

name: Silverclean
description: Pass silver qi through an ally's blood to draw out poison, curse residue or backlash and cast it off in a spent bead.

name: Mercury Flood
description: Release a wave of liquid metal that floods across the ground and wraps the legs of every foe before the user.

name: Silver Mantle
description: Wear a mantle of living silver that turns strokes aside and closes any wound it opens in itself.
